title: Igisagara cazimiye c'ubuninahazwa butagira uko bungana
intro: Ubuhinga bukomeye bwari bwaraganje ibice bininibinini vyo kw’isi, bukaba bwari buzwi cane kubera inyubakwa ziteye igomwe zishika mw’ijuru. Yamara munsi y’ubwo bukuru, hariho ukwihakana kw’ubutagondwa kwakuze — kwanka kwumviriza umugabisha w’Imana yarungitswe avuye mu kibano ubwaco. Ubwibone n’ubwibone vyari vuba gutuma haba igihano nk’ico isi canke ijuru bitari bwigere bibona.
clues: Twarigeze gutwara ibice bininibinini vy’isi, twirata inkomezi twizera ko ata yindi nteguro yoshobora kuzigereranya.
Ubwami bwacu bwari buzwi cane kubera inyubakwa ziteye igomwe zifise inkingi zikomeye zari zihagaze ata n’umwe azigereranya mu gihugu cose cari kizwi.
Umugabisha wo mu kibano cacu bwite yarahagurutse, ahimiriza umwe wese muri twebwe kuyobokera Umuremyi umwe wenyene.
Twarahakanye ubutumwa twashikirijwe, twanka guheba inzira twarazwe.
Umuyaga w’uburake, uboroga cane w’ubukazi burengeje urugero waraduteye, maze turadusiga ata co twikingira.
Twarasigaye nk’ibiti vy’imisukoni vyitoboye, bitataniye kandi vyibagiwe, nk’icigwa ku ruvyaro rwose ruzokurikira.
